classification: preregistered read-only data provenance audit; not alpha or return evidence

classification_rules.auxiliary_nontrading: R305 auxiliary qfq key has tradestatus=0; this is only a source label
classification_rules.auxiliary_trading: R305 auxiliary qfq key has tradestatus=1; this is only a source label
classification_rules.auxiliary_unresolved: no exact auxiliary qfq key match in R305
classification_rules.provider_absent_empty_symbol: provider returned no rows at all for the symbol in the requested window; cannot distinguish delisting, suspension, or source omission
classification_rules.provider_absent_for_returned_symbol: provider returned at least one row for the symbol but not the exact key
classification_rules.provider_invalid_bar: exact key returned but OHLC or volume fails the validity rule
classification_rules.provider_valid_bar: exact key returned with positive open/high/low/close and non-negative volume

decision_rule.never: do not write provider rows into production data, do not run a factor backtest, and do not change any candidate status in this round
decision_rule.otherwise: record the gap as unresolved; do not impute, backfill, or infer alpha
decision_rule.strong_recovery: if provider_valid_bar covers at least 80% of all 3,586 absent keys, recommend a separate canonical backfill round only after explicit approval
decision_rule.unresolved_recovery: if provider_valid_bar covers at least 50% of the 540 auxiliary-unresolved keys, recommend a separate provenance/backfill round for that subset

gates.P1_exact_absent_key_reconstruction: R308 reconstructs exactly 3,586 absent keys with zero duplicate keys and matches the R305 aggregate
gates.P2_provider_symbol_coverage: at least 95% of the absent-key symbol union returns at least one provider row in the requested window
gates.P3_classification_partition: all four provider classifications sum exactly to the reconstructed absent-key count
gates.P4_no_write_or_input_drift: all frozen input hashes match before and after the audit; canonical daily and enriched directories are unchanged
gates.P5_no_outcome_fields: the result contains no return, forward outcome, adjusted price, or performance metric

question: For the exact R78 member-day keys absent from canonical daily K-line partitions, can the project AkShare provider return a valid unadjusted daily bar, and how does that recovery differ between the 2,988 tradable, 58 non-trading, and 540 unresolved auxiliary buckets?

scope.canonical_bars: data/kline_daily/date=*/part.parquet, filtered to R78 date range
scope.join: exact (date, symbol) equality; no forward fill, ticker rewriting, current-member substitution, or date shifting
scope.provider_price_mode: unadjusted daily; only key presence and OHLC validity are inspected
